events.title: OCAY gear sale: crash pads, harnesses, climbing shoes
events.summary: OCAY is selling leftover climbing gear before break: crash pads at $40 each (3 available), harnesses at $15 each, and climbing shoes in assorted sizes at $10 a pair. Claim by replying to the email; pickup at the OCAY shed through Nov 20.
evidence: Pickup at the OCAY shed through Nov 20.
